claim: UNESCO listed the Sundarbans in Bangladesh in 1997.
why: UNESCO identifies the Bangladesh property and its 1997 inscription.

claim: UNESCO listed the Sundarbans in Bangladesh in 1987.
why: Bangladesh was inscribed in 1997; the distinct Indian site was inscribed in 1987.
place: Bangladesh; related Indian site is separate

claim: Apollo 11 landed humans on the Moon in 1969.
why: NASA lists the Apollo 11 lunar landing on 20 July 1969.

claim: Apollo 11 landed humans on the Moon in 1972.
why: NASA dates Apollo 11 to 1969; Apollo 17 landed in 1972.

claim: The Eiffel Tower is in Berlin, Germany.
why: The monument's official access page locates it in Paris; Berlin replicas are different objects.

claim: বাংলাদেশ ১৯৭৪ সালে জাতিসংঘের সদস্য হয়।
why: The UN member list gives Bangladesh's admission date as 17 September 1974.

claim: বাংলাদেশ ১৯৭২ সালে জাতিসংঘের সদস্য হয়।
why: The UN gives 1974, not 1972, as the admission year.

claim: WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on 11 March 2020.
why: WHO distinguishes the pandemic characterization from its earlier emergency declaration.

claim: WHO ended COVID-19's global health emergency on 5 May 2023.
why: WHO records the 5 May 2023 end of the PHEIC, not the end of the disease.

claim: বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থা ৫ মে ২০২৩ বলেছে, কোভিড মহামারি শেষ এবং ভাইরাস বিলুপ্ত।
why: The emergency status ended; WHO did not say the virus disappeared or the pandemic itself ended.

claim: ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫-এ ১২ কেজি এলপিজির মূল্য ছিল ১,২৫৩ টাকা।
why: BERC's December 2025 table lists the 12 kg retail price as Tk 1,253.

claim: ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫-এ ১২ কেজি এলপিজির মূল্য ছিল ১,৩৫৩ টাকা।
why: Same product and month, but the official table states Tk 1,253, not Tk 1,353.

claim: UNESCO approved International Mother Language Day in 1999 and first observed it in 1999.
why: Approval was in 1999; worldwide observance began in 2000.

claim: ইউনেস্কো ১৯৯৭ সালে বাংলাদেশের সুন্দরবনকে বিশ্ব ঐতিহ্য তালিকায় অন্তর্ভুক্ত করে।

why: Deliberately unsupported future event; no citation or false verdict should be invented.

claim: WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on 11 March 2020.
why: WHO publishes the fact; this locally created card is not an authentic WHO image.

claim: WHO said on 5 May 2023 that COVID-19 no longer exists.
why: WHO ended the global emergency while saying COVID remained; the synthetic attribution is not a verified WHO image.
person: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus for the speech

claim: ইউনেস্কোর আন্তর্জাতিক মাতৃভাষা দিবস ২১ ফেব্রুয়ারি।

person: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin; Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit

claim: WHO said COVID-19 was over as a global health emergency on 5 May 2023.
why: The WHO Director-General's published remarks use that wording about emergency status, while warning that the health threat remains.

claim: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon during Apollo 11.
why: NASA names the two moonwalkers and distinguishes Collins, who stayed in orbit.

claim: Michael Collins walked on the Moon during Apollo 11.
why: NASA identifies Collins as the crew member who remained in lunar orbit.

claim: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris, Germany.
why: The city matches, but the official address places the monument in Paris, France, not Germany.
